table fr name text, day date
remind "It's a birthday today" at fr.day
each fr sort day as f
  row card gap 2 tap edit f swipe remove f
    f.name bold grow
    f.day faint
form fr
after:
app "Birthdays" gift plum
table fr name text, day date, phone text?
remind "It's a birthday today" at fr.day
each fr sort day as f
  row card gap 2 tap edit f swipe remove f
    f.name bold grow
    f.day faint
form fr
changes: adds field fr.phone (text); old rows have it empty
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: chatty with a reason why the person needs it, 22 to 38 words
order: start with the problem or reason
